description: Non-material amendment to Ref: 22/01181/FUL to allow alterations to fenestration, external materials, eaves height together with added ventilation units.
decision_conditions: With regard to Section 96A of The Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (As Amended 2024), the proposal would represent a non-material change. The works would not require planning permission.For the purposes of this decision, Condition no.2 of planning permission 22/01181/FUL shall be replaced with the following condition: REPLACEMENT CONDITION 2: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:Location PlanExisting Site Plan  - E135Proposed Site Plan - P120 Rev. 2*Proposed Floor and Elevations Plan  - P130 Rev. 2*Proposed Elevations and Roof Plan - P131 Rev. 2*Proposed Long Elevations Plan - P132Proposed Section Plan - P134 Rev. 2*SuDS Assessment received 29.03.2023Design and Access Statement received 05.05.2023Daylight / Sunlight Plan - P121Rendered Visualisation3D Rendering Plan - P133Proposed Cladding*Acoustic Report ref:   GCR_BAF_150526N99LE dated 15.05.2026*Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.NB - * denotes the revised plans/documents which have been updated on the original Condition 2.
